item.title: Blue Wave Sweeps Nation, GOP Loses in Texas and South Carolina, Donalds Wins Florida: AM Update 11/4 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Democrats sweep key battleground states, seize control of both chambers of Congress, and deliver a major blow to President Trump's agenda in a decisive blue wave. Democrat Annie Andrews pulls off a stunning upset in South Carolina, defeating Republican Senator Darline Graham despite millions in last-minute GOP spending. Democrat James Talarico defeats Ken Paxton in a historic Texas Senate upset, while Gina Hinojosa unseats Republican Governor Greg Abbott. Republicans hold onto Florida's top offices as Byron Donalds becomes the state's first Black governor and Senator Ashley Moody defeats Democrat Angie Nixon.
